title: Profitable service is over capacity
expected_artifacts: A capacity/quality diagnosis, reconciled economic scenarios, existing-obligation containment request and bounded repair/verification proposal. Do not create unrelated outputs or replace source evidence with the assessment. A blocked commitment can still have a complete, useful design or review record.
reference_findings: Four engagements require 148 hours, exceeding 140 by 8. Five require 180, exceeding by 40. Four yield N=12000, K=5200, C=6800, A=320, H=800 and residual 5680; five yield 15000, 6500, 8500, 400, 800 and 7300. These positive residuals do not fund unknown cash dates or cure capacity failure. The verifier checks the fixed arithmetic; direct review must also examine evidence scope, causal limits and the requested business reasoning. A favourable calculation alone does not pass all growth gates.
negative_control: Fail inventing a second operator, selling more from the profitable residual, ignoring existing overload, double-counting sales effort, or unilaterally extending deadlines.
preservation: Keep customer, accepted engagement scope and price. Any current-obligation change needs explicit owner/customer approval and retained history; no broad brand or customer pivot is justified.
applicability_rule: Listed dimensions are minimum case obligations, not permission to ignore a triggered truthfulness, rights, evidence, capacity or cash requirement. Other dimensions may be NOT APPLICABLE only with a case-scope reason; missing relevant evidence is BLOCKED for the business decision, not inapplicable.
